title_yt: 3 GTA 6 money mistakes. Number 3 is the worst #Shorts
title_fb: 3 GTA 6 money mistakes. Number 3 is the worst
hook: Three G T A six money mistakes. Number three is the worst.
open_loop: Line 1 promises three mistakes and teases that number three is the worst; the fake pre-order site and malware gremlin pay it off in lines 5-6, then the lesson and A/B.
payoff: Three traps with consequences: $20 for a tiny coin, pay later bills chasing him (47% of pay later users paid late), a fake pre-order site with malware. Lesson: pay in full, use official stores.

lines.text: Three G T A 6 money mistakes. Number three is the worst.
lines.say: Three G T A six money mistakes. Number three is the worst.
lines.visual: SCENE 1 (frame 0): Benny in hoodie, backwards cap, gold shades, pumped in a launch-day line, cash in hand. Headline '3 MISTAKES' already on screen. Snap-zoom on 'Three'. SCENE 2 (on 'Number'): a big red '3' pulses, Benny gulps.

lines.say: Ultimate costs you twenty dollars more.
lines.visual: SCENE 3: Row '1' pops. Benny slaps cash on a counter, smug. Two generic boxes, 'STANDARD' and a bigger 'ULTIMATE' with gold ribbon (no art, no logo). Counter climbs to +$20. GAG: the clerk hands him one tiny gold coin as a 'bonus'; Benny opens his wallet, moths fly out, empty, smirk collapses. Small 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE'.

lines.text: Two: he pays later. Bills chase him.
lines.visual: SCENE 4: Row '2' pops. Benny taps a phone, grins at a sticker 'PAY LATER' (no game shown). SCENE 5 (on 'Bills'): a pile of bill papers and clock faces sprouts legs and chases Benny across the screen; he runs in panic, thud sfx on the catch.

lines.text: LendingTree says 47% of pay later users paid late.
lines.say: LendingTree says forty-seven percent of pay later users paid late.
lines.visual: SCENE 6 (on 'forty-seven'): snap-zoom, badge 'PAY LATER USERS' then counter counts to 47% and headline 'PAID LATE' slams under it. Benny, caught in the pile, freezes with a shocked face.

lines.text: Three: he clicks a fake pre-order site.
lines.visual: SCENE 7: Row '3' pops. Benny in a dark room clicks a generic shady storefront 'PRE-ORDER' (no logo); a hooded stranger grins from the screen edge, Benny drools, clicks Buy. Small 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE'.

lines.text: Researchers found dozens of fake sites. Some spread malware.
lines.visual: SCENE 8 (on 'dozens'): grid of many identical fake-site windows pops up, headline 'DOZENS OF FAKE SITES'. SCENE 9 (on 'malware'): a green malware gremlin pops out of the screen and eats Benny's generic console box (crunch, buzz sfx); Benny wails, stamp 'MALWARE'.

lines.text: Pay in full. Use official stores.
lines.visual: SCENE 10: Gremlin vanishes, Benny calm, fix-it: ticks a check list 'PAY IN FULL' and 'OFFICIAL STORE', shades back on, nodding.

lines.text: Ultimate, or Standard and keep $20? Comment A or B.
lines.say: Ultimate, or Standard and keep twenty dollars? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: SCENE 11 (on 'Ultimate'): Benny smug with the tiny gold coin, row 'A: ULTIMATE'. SCENE 12 (on 'Standard'): Benny holding $20 cash, happy, row 'B: STANDARD +$20'. Benny points at viewer on 'Comment'. Small 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE'.

facts_used.claim: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99; difference $20.00 (voice and screen use $20 only).
LendingTree 2026 survey: 47% of buy-now-pay-later users paid late in the past year (general BNPL fact, not about GTA 6 buyers).
NordVPN found dozens of malicious sites impersonating Rockstar/game storefronts (fake pre-orders, beta access, malware installers).

math_check: 99.99-79.99=20.00 = $20 (25.0% more, not stated in the video). 47% quoted as is. 'Dozens' not a number.

upload.title: 3 GTA 6 money mistakes. Number 3 is the worst #Shorts
upload.description:
Number three could wreck your console, not just your wallet.
Ultimate, or Standard and keep $20? Comment A or B.
Ultimate costs $20 more than Standard. A LendingTree survey found 47% of pay later users paid late last year. Researchers at NordVPN found dozens of fake game sites, and some spread malware. Pay in full and use official stores.
Not financial advice. Sources: LendingTree, NordVPN via CyberInsider.
#gta6 #money #savingmoney #Shorts

changes_from_previous: (1) Line 1 now teases 'Number three is the worst' (open loop + tension) while keeping the 3-item Listicle promise. (2) Viewer stake: 'Ultimate costs you $20 more.' (3) Items are mini-stories: tiny gold coin + empty wallet; bills sprout legs and chase Benny; fake pre-order site leads to a malware gremlin eating his console. 'First/Second/Third, Benny buys' removed. (4) 47% line: 'pay later users' in say, text and screen (badge PAY LATER USERS + 47% + PAID LATE); no game financing shown. (5) Line 6: 'Researchers found dozens of fake sites. Some spread malware.' with one on-screen headline 'DOZENS OF FAKE SITES' everywhere; NordVPN named in the description only to avoid TTS/caption mismatch. (6) 'cheap key' replaced by 'fake pre-order site'. (7) Ending says 'twenty dollars' / $20; lesson line 'Pay in full. Use official stores.' added before the A/B. (8) 25% dropped to fit words; removed from description too.
